title: Asking For It
label: ch:ml-venam
canDo: I can ask somebody whether they want something.

payoff.summary: From cold: offer tea, and give both answers -- the acceptance and the refusal the track already had.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly one atom and the payoff assesses it. veno is venam plus the -o particle ML-C70-o already taught, so the reader builds it in the warm-up; venam itself lives in chapter 58 beside its negative.
